metadata.title: Ejection of high-velocity stars from the Galactic Center by an inspiraling Intermediate-Mass Black Hole

notes: No individual star is identified as a Galactic unbound candidate in the supplied material. The paper is a theoretical population study. The only mention of a specific high-velocity star is an uncatalogued prior-work reference to “a high-velocity star in SDSS data” at T:p1-b10; that object is not named or analyzed here.
